Read a Local Stanford TaskNet Inventory

Source: R/tasknet.R
onet_tasknet_read.Rd

Reads a manually acquired TaskNet CSV without downloading or caching it. Study identifiers and ratings remain separate from official O*NET archive identifiers and estimates. Real TaskNet data are not bundled.

Usage

onet_tasknet_read(
  path,
  source_url = NULL,
  as_of = NULL,
  expected_sha256 = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Path to an existing local UTF-8 CSV file.

source_url

Optional public HTTP(S) source URL, supplied by the caller.

as_of

Optional caller-supplied snapshot label.

expected_sha256

Optional expected SHA-256 digest of the input bytes.

Value

A tibble with study_task_id, inventory, region, title, onet_soc_code, task, raw relationship columns, numeric task ratings, and character research-score fields. Additional source columns remain character. Known optional columns are present even when absent from the file. Provenance columns are source_path, source_url, source_sha256, source_read_at, source_as_of, and integer source_record. The full source receipt is also retained as an attribute.

Details

Required columns are id, inventory, region, occupation, soc, statement, refines, refined_by, overlaps, relevance, importance, and frequency. Empty rating cells become NA_real_; nonempty invalid numbers are errors. Relevance and share ratings use 0–1, importance 1–5, frequency 1–7, and duration and training 1–9. Fractional summaries are retained without interpreting categories as time shares or exposure.

The reader validates all relationship endpoints against the complete file. refines and refined_by must be reciprocal, as must overlaps. Endpoints must share an occupation code and belong to opposite inventories. TaskNet rows may be new or overlap; comparison rows may be missing or overlap. These labels describe inventory comparisons, not time change.

The source id is a study ID even on O*NET comparison rows. No official task ID, release, or Core/Supplemental status is inferred. Research scores are preserved as character source fields, not endorsed or selected.

The digest identifies exactly the bytes parsed. Source URL and as_of are caller assertions, not independently verified metadata. Read time is not download time. Provenance describes the source bytes, not later edits. onet_tasknet_relations() requires the unmodified reader result; construct links before filtering either table. Header-only files return typed empties. Confirm the separate CSV's redistribution terms before sharing real rows.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "tasknet-synthetic.csv", package = "onet2r")
tasks <- onet_tasknet_read(path, as_of = "synthetic example")
tasks[c("study_task_id", "inventory", "importance")]
#> # A tibble: 9 × 3
#>   study_task_id inventory importance
#>   <chr>         <chr>          <dbl>
#> 1 S-FIX-01      TaskNet            4
#> 2 S-FIX-02      TaskNet            5
#> 3 S-FIX-03      TaskNet            3
#> 4 S-FIX-04      TaskNet            2
#> 5 O-FIX-01      O*NET              4
#> 6 O-FIX-02      O*NET              3
#> 7 O-FIX-03      O*NET              2
#> 8 S-AUX-01      TaskNet            4
#> 9 O-AUX-01      O*NET              4
onet_tasknet_relations(tasks)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 13
#>   from_study_task_id to_study_task_id relation_type onet_soc_code from_inventory
#>   <chr>              <chr>            <chr>         <chr>         <chr>         
#> 1 S-FIX-01           O-FIX-01         refines       15-1252.00    TaskNet       
#> 2 S-FIX-02           O-FIX-01         refines       15-1252.00    TaskNet       
#> 3 S-FIX-02           O-FIX-02         refines       15-1252.00    TaskNet       
#> 4 S-FIX-03           O-FIX-02         overlaps      15-1252.00    TaskNet       
#> 5 S-AUX-01           O-AUX-01         overlaps      31-1122.00    TaskNet       
#> # ℹ 8 more variables: to_inventory <chr>, from_source_record <int>,
#> #   to_source_record <int>, source_path <chr>, source_url <chr>,
#> #   source_sha256 <chr>, source_read_at <chr>, source_as_of <chr>
